summary: The request was to retry job 20261108-023653-70wy, which means redoing the firstmate long-running-sessions (M2) study and fixing the spec coverage gap that had made cargo test fail. The candidate does only the second part. It adds requirements OLY-A-55 to OLY-A-60 to docs/spec.toml, one for each BRIEF.md addendum dated 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-08. I ran the xtask spec test file and all 30 tests pass, including the coverage tests. CI also recorded cargo test as passing. But there is no studies/firstmate-long-running-sessions/ directory, and crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs is unchanged. The CHANGELOG entry says outright that the M2 study is not included because "its sources were not available in this job". So criteria 1, 2, 3 and 4 are unmet, and criterion 6 is unmet because the changelog has no M2 study entry. The study was the main deliverable, so the verdict is fail.
